Per protocol rule 6, promotion to a real slot is the selector's step.

h66_2_review.submit_rationale: No local instrument can be shown to transfer to the hidden population. On the only proxy correlated with the live board (credit-per-dot vs 14 owner-reported scores, Spearman rho=+0.749, p=0.002), the artifact measures +57 % over the live-best 0.2778 artifact at matched mass; but the same proxy shows a terrain-only control above every LiDAR arm off-range-front, and the incumbent is ~1.9x better per dot in the basin stratum, which is 99.95 % of this artifact's mass is NOT. Per the project protocol (no lottery-ticket uploads, promotion is a separate selector step) this artifact is offered for download and audit only.
